content.what_it_is: Comment-only placeholder. The header calls the file mod_storm.F at L14 and describes a future METEO module for wind, pressure, meteotsunami and landslide sources at L57-L58, but the file ends with an 'end meteo' comment at L65 and contains no Fortran module, declarations, procedures or executable statements.

verbatim_spans.text: !  METEO is a module to model wind and pressure effects

unresolved: The filename/header interface is inconsistent: the physical path is mod_meteo.f90, the embedded FILE label says mod_storm.F at L14, and the prose promises a METEO module at L57, but no MODULE declaration exists. Any build or caller expecting METEO from this unit would receive no symbol; the intended implementation location is not stated.
